subject.title: [Bug]: Codex runtime collapses automatic WhatsApp reply blocks into one bubble

question: Should newline chunking remain a size-aware paragraph-packing mode, or should it become a preserve-paragraph-sends policy across all runtimes and channels?
rationale: Current main intentionally packs adjacent paragraphs, while the proposed fix changes visible send boundaries beyond the reported Codex/WhatsApp path; source evidence cannot choose that user-facing compatibility contract on maintainers’ behalf.

options.title: Retain packed newline behavior
options.body: Keep the existing shared policy and close the active separation proposal unless maintainers identify a narrower established contract that it violates.

options.title: Adopt preserve-paragraph sends
options.body: Approve a shared planner-level policy, require upgrade and multi-channel delivery coverage, and land the open PR only after it is refreshed against current main.

recommendation.title: Retain packed newline behavior
recommendation.body: Keep the existing shared policy and close the active separation proposal unless maintainers identify a narrower established contract that it violates.

likelyOwner.reason: The current contract traces to their merged shared-planner work, making them the strongest feature-history routing candidate.
